Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,glob,re
def load():

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def transform2(g):
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps={col:comps4(g,col) for col in cnt if col!=bg}
    uniq=[(col,cs[0]) for col,cs in comps.items() if len(cs)==1]
    mcol,mcells=max(uniq,key=lambda t:len(t[1]))
    mc=centroid(mcells)
    allc=[cc for col,cs in comps.items() for cc in cs if len(cc)>=3]
    # model: non-marker shape closest to marker by centroid distance
    model=min(allc,key=lambda cc: dist(centroid(cc),mc))
    mn=norm(model)
    # candidates: other shapes, ranked by normalized symmetric difference to model
    def sd(n1,n2):
        return len((set(n1)-set(n2))|(set(n2)-set(n1)))
    others=[cc for cc in allc if set(cc)!=set(model)]
    best=min(sd(norm(cc),mn) for cc in others)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for cc in others:
        if sd(norm(cc),mn)==best:
            for r,c in cc: out[r][c]=mcol
    return out,model,mcol,best

def isL(cells):
    # L-shape: cells = union of one full vertical arm and one full horizontal arm sharing corner
    rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c in cells]
    for (r0,c0) in cells:
        up=[(r,c0) for r in range(r0,r0+9) if (r,c0) in cells]
        dn=[(r,c0) for r in range(r0-8,r0+1) if (r,c0) in cells]
        for arm in (up,dn):
            for arm2 in ([[ (r0,c) for c in range(c0,c0+9) if (r0,c) in cells],
                          [(r0,c) for c in range(c0-8,c0+1) if (r0,c) in cells]]):
                if len(arm)+len(arm2)-1==len(cells) and set(arm)|set(arm2)==set(cells):
                    return True
    return False

def transform3(g):
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps={col:comps4(g,col) for col in cnt if col!=bg}
    allc=[cc for col,cs in comps.items() for cc in cs]
    Ls=[cc for cc in allc if isL(cc) and len(cc)>=3]
    marker=max(Ls,key=len)
    mc=centroid(marker); mset=set(marker)
    shapes=[cc for cc in allc if set(cc)!=mset]
    model=min(shapes,key=lambda cc: dist(centroid(cc),mc))
    mn=norm(model)
    grp=[cc for cc in shapes if norm(cc)==mn and set(cc)!=set(model)]
    def sd(n1,n2): return len((set(n1)-set(n2))|(set(n2)-set(n1)))
    if not grp:  # fall back to most similar
        best=min(sd(norm(cc),mn) for cc in shapes)
        grp=[cc for cc in shapes if sd(norm(cc),mn)==best]
    target=max(grp,key=lambda cc: dist(centroid(cc),mc))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r,c in target: out[r][c]=g and max((v for row in g for v in row if v!=bg), key=lambda v:0) or 0
    return out,marker,target

open('programs/task-cfbfc911.py','w').write('''from collections import Counter, deque

def comps4(g,col):
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            if g[r][c]==col and (r,c) not in seen:
                q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cc=[]
                while q:
                    x,y=q.popleft(); cc.append((x,y))
                    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        a,b=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=a<R and 0<=b<C and g[a][b]==col and (a,b) not in seen:
                            seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
                out.append(cc)
    return out

def norm(cells):
    r0=min(r for r,_ in cells); c0=min(c for _,c in cells)
    return frozenset((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells)

def centroid(cells):
    n=len(cells); return (sum(r for r,_ in cells)/n, sum(c for _,c in cells)/n)

def dist(a,b): return ((a[0]-b[0])**2+(a[1]-b[1])**2)**0.5

def isL(cells):
    S=set(cells); R=max(r for r,_ in cells)+1; C=max(c for _,c in cells)+1
    for (r0,c0) in S:
        av=[[(r,c0) for r in range(r0,R) if (r,c0) in S],
            [(r,c0) for r in range(r0,-1,-1) if (r,c0) in S]]
        ah=[[(r0,c) for c in range(c0,C) if (r0,c) in S],
            [(r0,c) for c in range(c0,-1,-1) if (r0,c) in S]]
        for a1 in av:
            for a2 in ah:
                if len(a1)+len(a2)-1==len(S) and set(a1)|set(a2)==S: return True
    return False

def transform(g):
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    allc=[cc for col in cnt if col!=bg for cc in comps4(g,col)]
    Ls=[cc for cc in allc if isL(cc) and len(cc)>=3]
    marker=max(Ls,key=len)
    mcol=g[marker[0][0]][marker[0][1]]
    mc=centroid(marker); mset=set(marker)
    shapes=[cc for cc in allc if set(cc)!=mset]
    model=min(shapes,key=lambda cc: dist(centroid(cc),mc))
    mn=norm(model)
    grp=[cc for cc in shapes if norm(cc)==mn and set(cc)!=set(model)]
    def sd(n1,n2): return len((set(n1)-set(n2))|(set(n2)-set(n1)))
    if not grp:
        best=min(sd(norm(cc),mn) for cc in shapes)
        grp=[cc for cc in shapes if sd(norm(cc),mn)==best]
    target=max(grp,key=lambda cc: dist(centroid(cc),mc))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r,c in target: out[r][c]=mcol
    return out
''')

    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]

    mcol=g[marker[0][0]][marker[0][1]]
    mc=centroid(marker); mset=set(marker)
    shapes=[cc for cc in allc if set(cc)!=mset]
    model=min(shapes,key=lambda cc: dist(centroid(cc),mc))
    mn=norm(model)
    grp=[cc for cc in shapes if norm(cc)==mn and set(cc)!=set(model)]
    def sd(n1,n2): return len((set(n1)-set(n2))|(set(n2)-set(n1)))
    if not grp:
        best=min(sd(norm(cc),mn) for cc in shapes)
        grp=[cc for cc in shapes if sd(norm(cc),mn)==best]
